summary: Bitwarden is a self-hosted password manager that lets you store and synchronise credentials across multiple devices. It provides interfaces including a web application, browser extensions, and mobile apps to manage your sensitive data.
goodFor: It suits individuals or organisations who want to retain full control over their authentication credentials and sensitive data on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: Running your own password manager introduces a critical single point of failure; if your server experiences downtime or data loss, accessing your credentials becomes much harder.
deployNotes: Deployment typically relies on Docker and requires persistent storage volumes to preserve your database and configuration state. You will also need to configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for secure client connections.
